text:
sara_sales: Quick Q — prepping RFI packet for NovaHealth. Need final answers on POC SLOs, KMS/HSM, and the capability matrix w/ feature parity notes. Can we lock this today? :calendar:

mike_se: I can pull the capability matrix together. What SLOs should we commit to for the POC (p50/p95)? Also need a pricing ballpark for ~100k tokens/day so finance can eyeball the request.

jess_eng: For a standard POC we usually show p50 < 120ms for chat on Dedicated (A100x8). p95 varies with seq len — with moderate batching p95 ~ 350–500ms. I can add a short note: 'latency is workload dependent; see seq-length & batching caveats'.

omar_sec: KMS notes: we support CMK via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. HSM-backed key store is available for Private/on-prem. For Hosted we can offer BYOK with HSM-backed KMS under Enterprise contract (requires paperwork). I'll draft exact wording.

emily_prod: SLA recap: Hosted API: 99.9% for paid tiers. Dedicated: 99.95 with BC add-on. For a 30-day POC we treat it as evaluation (no SLA) unless customer signs an interim SLA. Want that spelled out in the RFI?

jess_eng: Capability snippet to copy into the matrix:
```
Supported modes: text-gen, chat, embeddings, reranking
Model catalog: curated open models + verified performance profiles
Quantization: 8-bit (q8), 4-bit (q4f) where applicable
KV cache: prefix & persistent KV cache (Dedicated/Private)
Latency notes: p50/p95 examples on A100; results dependent on seq length and batching
```

mike_se: Pricing (very rough): Hosted gen ~ $0.003/token (estimate) — I'll confirm with finance. Dedicated = reserved monthly + usage; I will add a sample TCO calc in the spreadsheet.

sara_sales: Add a data residency row — NovaHealth requires EU-only for PII. Also they asked about audit logs and retention terms.

omar_sec: Data residency: hosted region pinning available (eu-west1). Private = customer-controlled. Audit logs available for Dedicated & Private; retention configurable with add-on. Will add SOC2 and ISO statements.

mike_se: I'll add a 'caveats' column in the matrix for sequence-length & quantization tradeoffs and a 'deployment notes' column for residency/HSM.

deploy-bot: deployer: upload complete: capabilities_matrix_v2.xlsx uploaded to shared drive — https://drive/repo/abc123 :white_check_mark:

sara_sales: Omar, can you paste the KMS/HSM paragraph we should drop into the RFI? Legal wants exact wording.

omar_sec: Draft wording (legal-safe):
'Customer-managed keys (CMK) are supported via AWS KMS and GCP KMS for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API, bring-your-own-key (BYOK) with HSM-backed KMS is available under Enterprise contract; Redwood does not retain customer key material. HSM appliances are available for on-prem Private installations upon request.'

emily_prod: Add SLA caveat to the RFI: 'SLA applies to production accounts after onboarding and agreed payment terms. POC usage is considered evaluation and is not covered by the standard SLA unless otherwise contracted.'

sara_sales: Perfect — Mike, attach final matrix + pricing and I'll submit the RFI by EOD. :thumbsup:

mike_se: On it. ETA 3pm PT.

deploy-bot: file update: capabilities_matrix_v2.xlsx (final) at https://drive/repo/abc123 — checksum: sha256:aa11bb22cc33 :package:
